I replied to Marcus in your DM to confirm I have it: his standing call with the Tamsin Cold Chain team for the Driftwood rollout is now Tuesdays at 10:15. He said no action was needed, so I didn't change his calendar.

I didn't write a separate note to the knowledge brain. His direct message is already saved there automatically, and only he can see it. The tool for adding a separate note didn't show who would be able to see it, so I left it alone. That way his message stays private and doesn't end up in anyone else's conversation.
